0.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_000
0.description: I oversee the distribution of materials and the delegation of various essential tasks. It is a great responsibility that the elders have given me, and I shall prove to them and everyone else that I am up to the challenge!

1.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_010
1.description: I hope this <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> finds you well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you have any questions regarding the reconstruction effort, I would be happy to answer them.

7.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_016
7.description: Our work has really only just begun. For the time being, we are channeling the bulk of our resources into the development of the Ten Thousand Stalls, that we might provide a rich variety of food to the people of the enclave...

8.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_017
8.description: Anything and everything you are willing to part with we will gladly accept─and I do mean anything. Furthermore, as a token of our appreciation, the Shazenkai will pay a small gratuity based on the total value of your contribution.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_018
9.description: I should warn you, however, that we have a limited budget allocated for this purpose...

10.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_019
10.description: You may donate items to the Shazenkai by placing them in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Donation Basket<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> next to Kozakura. The funds raised from the sale of these items will go towards the reconstruction of the Doman Enclave.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_020
11.description: Any items that can be sold to vendors may be donated.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_021
12.description: In exchange for items donated, you will receive a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gratuity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> that amounts to slightly more than what you would normally receive when selling said items to a vendor.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_022
13.description: Moreover, as the enclave develops, the gratuity you receive for items will gradually increase.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_023
14.description: However, the Shazenkai has a limited budget to pay gratuity for donations. Once the weekly budget has been exhausted, no more donations will be accepted.

16.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_025
16.description: Please be advised that should the calculated gratuity of a donation exceed the weekly budget, you will not receive the difference.

17.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_026
17.description: Ah, well... If you realize you made a donation in error, it is certainly possible for us to return to you your items, provided you notify us immediately...

18.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_027
18.description: Items donated to the Shazenkai may be retrieved from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reclamation Box<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

19.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_028
19.description: However, as is the case with vendor Buyback lists, donations cannot be reclaimed after you have changed areas or logged out.

20.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_100_028
20.description: Additionally, please be advised that your contribution to the Doman reconstruction effort will be reduced when reclaiming donations. Moreover, reclaiming donations will not increase or otherwise affect the weekly budget.

21.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_029
21.description: Furthermore, when reclaiming a donated item, you will be required to return the gratuity received, as well as pay a small transaction fee.

22.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_030
22.description: Before you think to make any further donations, I would ask that you go and speak with Mitsuba. You should know what you have helped to build.

23.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_040
23.description: I cannot say I expected to receive an offer of assistance from Budugan tribesmen, especially considering some of the more unusual rumors I had heard... Still, if they can help us to procure a wider variety of food, it would be most welcome.

24.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_041
24.description: As for the enclave, perhaps this map will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

25.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_050
25.description: You have yet to speak with Mitsuba, yes? I would encourage you to do so now. If you wish to make a donation, you may do so later.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_060
26.description: Though the Confederacy demands that all its members swear allegiance to it alone, I suspect many of the Domans among them still think fondly of their homeland. That we have more opportunities to aid one another is wonderful, is it not?

27.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_061
27.description: As for the enclave, perhaps this map will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

28.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_070
28.description: Now, now, this is not the time to be making donations! Let us go and enjoy the Ten Thousand Stalls in all their glory!

29.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_080
29.description: With the Ten Thousand Stalls complete, the Shazenkai may now proceed to its next plan: the Yard, a district where our people can create tools and goods for everyday use, as well as arts and crafts to sell in foreign markets.

30.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_081
30.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

31.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_090
31.description: Not that I wish to refuse you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I think it might be better if you were to go and see Master Tsuranuki before I accept another donation.

32.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_100
32.description: As for the Yard, work on Master Tsuranuki's domain is going well. He has a way of inspiring his subordinates to push themselves to their limits─and sometimes beyond. We shall have to keep an eye on them.

33.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_101
33.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

34.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_110
34.description: Have you spoken with Master Araragi yet? I think it would be for the best if you did. I will review any items you wish to donate afterwards.

35.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_120
35.description: Masters Tsuranuki and Araragi are terribly competitive, are they not? I should be glad to see both their visions realized without incident, though at present they appear to be making a race of it.

36.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_121
36.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

37.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_130
37.description: I am afraid I cannot accept donations at this time. A runner should be arriving for me any moment... In the meantime, perhaps you could go and speak with Master Tsuranuki? I will join you anon.

38.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_140
38.description: The Yard is a much more ambitious project than the Ten Thousand Stalls were. The quantity of materials required, never mind the labor, far exceeds our previous demands. I do hope you do not mind us asking so much of you.

39.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_141
39.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

40.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_150
40.description: Are you not interested in hearing what Master Araragi has to say? I should be glad to process any donations when you return.

41.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_160
41.description: The “race” between Masters Tsuranuki and Araragi grows more heated. I know I should not encourage them, but I must confess a small measure of excitement.

42.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_161
42.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

43.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_170
43.description: Donations can wait. You should go and see Master Tsuranuki's craftsmen hard at work. Believe me when I say it is inspiring!

44.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_180
44.description: Once Master Araragi's paper mill is operational, the Yard will be officially complete! We need only persevere for a little longer.

45.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_181
45.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

46.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_190
46.description: You are too kind to offer yet more donations. That said, we really should not keep Master Araragi waiting...

47.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_200
47.description: With the Ten Thousand Stalls and the Yard both complete, the Shazenkai is once more deliberating what plan to set in motion next. I've also observed Mitsuba and our master craftsmen discussing what seems to be a secret project─or at least a project they seem intent upon concealing from me, for whatever reason.

48.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_201
48.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

49.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_210
49.description: Personally, I think these garments do not suit me at all, but if parading myself in them improves our chances of earning the favor of wealthy patrons, then I shall grin and bear it for Doma...

50.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_210
50.description: While you may continue to donate to the Shazenkai, there will be no further developments until a future update.

51.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_215
51.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! A pleasure to see you, as always.

52.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_216
52.description: I am, however, concerned that we are keeping you from more urgent matters. Are there not others in greater need of your assistance?

53.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_217
53.description: In order to proceed with the reconstruction of the enclave, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Emissary of the Dawn.”

54.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_220
54.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Just the person with whom I was hoping to speak.

55.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_221
55.description: There have been some interesting developments in our plans for the enclave.

56.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_222
56.description: The Shazenkai and the residents have made a combined effort to clear away a vast amount of debris, opening up more land for us to develop.

57.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_223
57.description: We are considering a number of different projects, such as allocating land for farming, buildings for new enterprises, and so forth.

58.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_224
58.description: Naturally, our need for resources has never been greater. I do not speak only of material costs, but also of the labor required.

59.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_225
59.description: In order to adequately explain our next undertaking, I must─

60.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_226
60.description: (-???-)Sorry to interrupt, but perhaps it would be best coming from me.

61.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_227
61.description: (-Formidable Farmer-)We meet again, Warrior of Light. You may not remember me, but I was there the day you and Lady Yugiri freed me and my countrymen from Castrum Fluminis. I owe my freedom to you.

62.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_228
62.description: (-Formidable Farmer-)Though I must admit, I was in something of a panicked state when we first met. So much so, that I neglected to thank you or give my name. I am Ihase.

63.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_229
63.description: The Shazenkai has agreed to assist us with one of the newly opened patches of land. Like the rest of Yanxia, the enclave is blessed with a constant supply of clean water, ideally suited to rice farming. I was practically raised in a paddy field, and aim to put my experience to good use.

64.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_230
64.description: You see, now that a lot of the basic living quarters and such are in a decent state, a few of us would like to turn our attention to cultivating crops─rice in particular.

65.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_231
65.description: It is no exaggeration to say that it is our lifeblood. That is why I asked for permission to use the land.

66.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_IHASE_000_232
66.description: If you are not otherwise engaged, it would be a great honor to show you around. It is to the northwest, not far from here.

67.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_233
67.description: I for one am in total agreement with Ihase. Prosperous harvests would be an enormous boon as we strive towards self-sufficiency.

68.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_234
68.description: Any surplus produced would fetch a high price beyond our borders, and it would go a long way to the revival of the enclave.

69.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_235
69.description: Ihase and the other farmers have already started plotting out their, erm...plots. It would mean the world to them if you paid a visit.

70.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_240
70.description: It may not be long before we can eat homegrown rice─I can hardly wait! Being from Eorzea, you may not be aware of the subtle differences between varieties, but to us Domans, they are as clear as night and day.

71.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_250
71.description: Work on the paddy fields has begun in earnest. Unfortunately, we still have need of tools and such. I am told that time is of the essence, so any donations will be put to good use without delay!

72.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_251
72.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

73.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_260
73.description: Have you been to see Ihase? I think he has something to discuss with you.

74.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_280
74.description: If you have a chance, I recommend that you stop by the Enclave Demesne to see the good that your donations have done.

75.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_290
75.description: Now that rice production at the Enclave Demesne is well underway, work to rebuild Rissai-juku can begin. If all goes well, the school can play a role in passing on our knowledge and traditions to the next generation.

76.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_291
76.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

77.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_300
77.description: I recommend going to the school to see what a positive change your donations have brought about. And who knows─you may even learn something while you are there!

78.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_310
78.description: Despite the fact that construction is still ongoing, Minazuki has already started teaching at Rissa-juku! There is still a lot that needs doing, however.

79.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_311
79.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

80.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_320
80.description: It appears that the school has changed a great deal since the last time you went to see Minazuki. Why not see for yourself?

81.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_340
81.description: I cannot for the life of me imagine what the children wish to show us! There is only one way to find out, I suppose!

82.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_350
82.description: Now that Rissai-juku has everything it needs, we can focus on the Enclave Barracks. I hope you can find time to stop by.

83.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_351
83.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

84.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_360
84.description: If you speak with Mauto, he will explain everything. The barracks is not far from the Kienkan.

85.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_370
85.description: It looks like the Enclave Barracks are taking shape and Mauto is doing a tremendous job of overseeing the project.

86.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_371
86.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

87.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_380
87.description: I must remember not to call him “Mauty” in front of his subordinates─ He would be dreadfully embarrassed!

88.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_390
88.description: Now that we have a barracks, then next step is to build our own watchtower. You see, the more people move to the enclave, the greater the need to keep them safe.

89.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_391
89.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

90.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_400
90.description: Ishibushi and his team are taking care of the watchtower. He should be able to provide you with more information than I can, so I recommend passing by the docks to take a look.

91.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_410
91.description: With the old imperial watchtower gone, the next part of the plan is to construct one that is distinctly Doman. It should make for quite the landmark.

92.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_411
92.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

93.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_420
93.description: Never mind the donations for now─ Don't you want to congratulate Ishibushi on the completion of the watchtower?

94.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_430
94.description: I have managed to secure the resources that Ishibushi and Hachisuba requested, although I still have no idea what they intend to do with them.

95.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_431
95.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

96.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_440
96.description: I admit that when we first began the reconstruction, I had never considered having our very own garden here in the enclave. I am glad that we have reached the stage that such projects have become possible.

97.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_441
97.description: Perhaps this will give you a sense of how much progress we have made thus far...

98.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_450
98.description: I wonder what the One Garden looks like now!

99.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_KOZAKURA_000_460
99.description: If you still wish to make donations to the enclave, we would be overjoyed to accept them.

100.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_461
100.description: Although there will be no further expansion, you may continue to make donations within the weekly budget.

101.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONEVENTKOZAKURA_00486_SYSTEM_000_462
101.description: Furthermore, as a result of the enclave's expansion, the rate of gratuities paid for donations has increased, as well as the weekly budget.
